policy.productionActivationRequires: Production-eligible Travelpayouts observations and Agoda rates for the same city mapping strategy.
policy.mockEvidencePolicy: Injected or mock responses are validation-only and never activate a city.
policy.batchPolicy: Use bounded batches with checkpoint/resume; do not verify all 1,000 cities in one Lambda request.
policy.transientFailurePolicy: A single provider error does not permanently quarantine a city.
policy.recommendationPolicy: Pending, estimate-only, unresolved, or provider-error cities must not be described as fully provider-backed.
